source_scope: historical original Agents Builder capability, restored inside existing milestone IDs 0.50–0.55
note: 10 separately tracked product variants. These are tools for building agents, not ten separate agents. No extra milestone numbers have been invented for originally specified functionality.

status_taxonomy.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Not present in src/app binary tree or verified platform build
status_taxonomy.PARTIAL: Partial implementable source verified, real platform E2E pending
status_taxonomy.IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED: Real platform Code/NoCode acceptance with CI and artifact evidence

shared_requirements.scope: Common ocaf-builder-core typed agent DAG, schema, immutable project IDs, versions, agent manifest compiler and honest Code/NoCode capability negotiation.
shared_requirements.acceptance: Graph→DSL→Graph deterministic round-trip for supported DSL, schema version conversion and rejected unrepresentable constructs

shared_requirements.scope: A real source-code editing product with diagnostics, reusable agent graph libraries and controlled build/sandbox/debug/deploy; not merely an LLM coding agent.
shared_requirements.acceptance: Edit typed agent project, compile and run in constrained executor, edit history and durable revert

shared_requirements.scope: A real visual NoCode editor with palette, draggable nodes, typed edges, permission prompts, simulation and publish gating, not a static picture.
shared_requirements.acceptance: UI interactions persist correct typed graph, generate valid supported DSL, unsupported edge/action denied

shared_requirements.scope: Bidirectional supported-subset Code↔NoCode round trip; unsupported arbitrary Rust cannot silently claim semantic equivalence.
shared_requirements.acceptance: Executable program subset preserves properties and requires explicit lossiness warning

shared_requirements.scope: Agent graph permissions/cost guard, sandbox execution, run receipts, versioned signed export, package verification and explicit user-approved deployment.
shared_requirements.acceptance: Rogue tool edge, cyclic effects, malicious import, cross-tenant export or unauthorized deployment denied

shared_requirements.scope: Project gallery/template versioning, syntax hints, typed error messages, debugging trace and reproducible agent project snapshots.
shared_requirements.acceptance: Template creates real valid editable project; broken template fails validation and never publishes
